preconditions.description: The number of test cases T must be between 1 and 10,000.
The number of vertices N for each test case must be between 1 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: len(C) == N and all(c in 'RGB' for c in C)
preconditions.description: The string C must have length N and consist only of the characters 'R', 'G', and 'B'.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u <= N and 1 <= v <= N and u != v for u, v in edges)
preconditions.description: Each edge must connect two distinct vertices within the range of 1 to N.
The total number of vertices across all test cases must not exceed 200,000.

postconditions.description: For each test case, output 'Yes' if the input is valid, otherwise output 'No'.
